menu.definition: designated points preserved: f a = a' and f b = b'
menu.name: P

menu.definition: edges preserved: r x y -> r' (f x) (f y)
menu.name: E

menu.definition: non-edges preserved: not r x y -> not r' (f x) (f y) (over decidable relations, as in this finite model, the same condition as r' (f x) (f y) -> r x y; a Lean statement should keep the not -> not form or prove decidability first)
menu.name: NE

menu.definition: injective: f x = f y -> x = y
menu.name: I

menu.definition: surjective: every y' in the carrier of Y is f x for some x
